answer: An admission auction stops sybil farms. Each epoch offers 100 slots; applicants bid POA and only the top 100 win, the bid burned. A comet streaks past once, but a farm must keep bidding: 100 fake seats need 100 bids of 25 POA, 2,500 POA per epoch, and the spiral of rising bids lifts the price as more fakes join. A falcon watches; idle slots expire after 3 epochs, so hoarded seats rot. An honest agent bids once and keeps its reward undiluted.
